# Rubato

> Rubato speeds up videos dynamically. It transcribes a recording, slows down for takeaways, lists and key numbers, and speeds through filler and silence. Pitch is preserved and nothing is cut. Free and open source (MIT).

Rubato exists in five forms: a hosted connector (remote MCP server), an agent skill, a local MCP server, a command-line tool, and this web app with an HTTP API. Source: https://github.com/andreolf/rubato

Default speeds: takeaways, lists and key numbers 1.0x; ordinary passages 1.2x; filler and flat stretches 1.5x; dead air 2.0x. All are adjustable.

It is for recordings where someone talks: lectures, talks, meetings, interviews, podcasts, tutorials, narrated screen recordings. It is not a silence remover or jump-cut tool: it never removes content.

## If you are an AI agent asked to use Rubato on a video

Pick the first route available to you.

0. Hosted connector (remote MCP, streamable HTTP, no sign-in): {{SITE_URL}}/mcp
   - Listed in Claude's connector directory: https://claude.ai/directory/rubato
   - In Claude: Settings, Connectors, search "Rubato" in the directory and connect. Or add the address above as a custom connector.
   - Tools: `speed_up_video` (takes a direct public link to the media file; returns a job_id) and `get_result` (poll until stage is done; returns lengths, picked passages and a download link).
   - Limits: {{MAX_MINUTES}} minutes, {{MAX_MB}} MB. For a local file with no link, use a route below or the upload box on the site.
1. Agent skill. Install: `npx skills add andreolf/rubato`. Or read the skill instructions directly: {{REPO}}/blob/main/skills/rubato/SKILL.md
2. MCP server. Command: `uvx --from git+https://github.com/andreolf/rubato rubato-mcp`
   - Claude Code: `claude mcp add rubato -- uvx --from git+https://github.com/andreolf/rubato rubato-mcp`
   - JSON config: {"mcpServers": {"rubato": {"command": "uvx", "args": ["--from", "git+https://github.com/andreolf/rubato", "rubato-mcp"]}}}
   - Tools: `rubato_plan` (transcribe, pick passages, build the speed map; accepts marks), `rubato_transcript` (timestamped transcript), `rubato_render` (render from the plan).
3. Command line. `uvx --from git+https://github.com/andreolf/rubato rubato auto FILE` writes FILE.rubato.mp4 next to the input. Add `--plan-only` to preview.
4. HTTP API on this site, for files up to {{MAX_MINUTES}} minutes and {{MAX_MB}} MB, when you cannot run anything locally:
   - `POST {{SITE_URL}}/api/jobs` as multipart form data with field `file`. Optional fields: `base`, `slow`, `fast`, `silence` (speeds), `language`. Returns `{"id": "..."}`.
   - `GET {{SITE_URL}}/api/jobs/{id}` returns `stage` (queued, listening, transcribing, planning, rendering, done, error), and when done a `result` with lengths, the speed segments and the recognised passages.
   - `GET {{SITE_URL}}/api/jobs/{id}/file?download=1` returns the rendered MP4 (or M4A for audio).
   - Uploads are deleted after processing; results are kept for 30 minutes.
